author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX has officially set a launch date for Starship Flight 13, and after a record-breaking 33-engine static fire from Booster 20, launch is now just days away.

In this week's Starship Update we cover everything leading into Flight 13, including:

🚀 Booster 20's impressive static fire
🚀 Ship 40's current status
🚀 SpaceX's new Flight 13 mission profile
🚀 20 Starlink V3 satellites flying for the first time
🚀 Hot staging improvements
🚀 Raptor engine reliability upgrades
🚀 Behind-the-scenes footage from SpaceX's new "Critical Path" documentary
🚀 Progress on Booster 21, Booster 22, Ship 41, Ship 42, and Ship 43
🚀 McGregor's record-breaking 8-minute Raptor test
🚀 Pad 1 upgrades
🚀 Giga Bay construction
🚀 Florida's Starship launch complex at SLC-37

With launch currently targeting July 16, excitement is building as SpaceX prepares for another major step toward fully reusable Starship.

Will Flight 13 finally complete every major mission objective?
